excerpt.zh: 联合星殖民地在失去联系前大约运作了二十五年。无论这里发生了什么，记录都保存了下来。殖民地的档案管理员一直坚持记录到了最后。
excerpt.en: The Unity colony operated for roughly twenty-five years before contact was lost. Whatever happened here, the record survived. The colony's archivist kept logging until the end.

sections.en: The Unity colony operated for roughly twenty-five years before contact was lost. Whatever happened here, the record survived. The colony's archivist kept logging until the end.

texts.zh:
殖民地的数据核心幸存了下来——被封存在玻璃化表岩屑下方的地下档案馆中。

第9251天：发现了一种新的掘地变种。外围墙体的防护等级不足以抵御地下突破。已向“秋菊”号请求工程支援。请求待批复。

第9389天：外环已撤离。地下居住区已确认安置了214,000名殖民者。部分区域失去联系。

第9441天：与7至12区的通讯中断。民兵伤亡：892人。

第9484天：地下四层的电力已中断。团队被要求停止记录。档案管理员予以拒绝。

第9514天：我们没有足够的时间了。
texts.en:
The colony's data cores survived - sealed in a subterranean archive beneath vitrified regolith.

Day 9,251: A new burrowing variant has been identified. The outer perimeter walls are not rated for subsurface breach. Engineering support requested from the Chrysanthemum. Request pending.

Day 9,389: Outer ring evacuated. 214,000 colonists accounted for in underground residential blocks. Some sectors uncontacted.

Day 9,441: Communications with sectors 7 through 12 lost. Militia casualties: 892.

Day 9,484: Power to sublevel four is gone. The team has been asked to stop logging. The archivist declines.

Day 9,514: We do not have enough time.

texts.zh:
议事厅是为容纳两百人而建造的。最后一次会议只召集到了十七人。档案员仍在进行记录。

会议持续了六个小时。共投出十二张选票——六票赞成轨道轰炸，六票反对。一名委员弃权。三人缺席；他们所在的防区三天前就已沦陷。

反对者争辩说，撤离仍然可行。“秋菊号”可以在地表殖民地的下层被攻破前分批撤离幸存者。

多数人则不这么认为。该生物已经到达了下层通道。任何停靠的飞船都会将污染带离这个星球。现在的选择已经不再是拯救部分人还是拯救所有人，而是失去一个世界，还是失去随后的每一个世界。

殖民地安全主管博克莱尔指挥官投下了决定性的一票。动议通过。殖民地宪章规定少数服从多数。那份宪章是他们在第一年亲自起草的，那时的未来看起来还是另一番光景。
texts.en:
The council chamber was built for two hundred. The final session convened seventeen people. The archivist was still logging.

The session ran for six hours. Twelve votes were cast - six for orbital bombardment, six against. One member abstained. Three were absent; their sectors had fallen three days prior.

The dissenters argued that evacuation was still possible. The Chrysanthemum could extract survivors in cycles before the lower levels were breached.

The majority held otherwise. The organism had already reached the lower access tunnels. Any vessel that docked would carry contamination offworld. The choice was no longer between saving some and saving all, but between losing one world and losing every world that followed.

Chief of Colony Security, Commander Beauclair, cast the deciding vote. The motion carried. The colony's charter said majority rules. They had written that charter themselves, in the first year, when the future looked different.

texts.zh:
舰桥日志始于第9516天——即投票两天后。

11名船员留下来确认地表清除情况。辐射水平。人口预估被下调，随后再次下调。第9519天：授权轰炸。第9521天：确认扇区清除完毕，40%。第9558天：地表已彻底净化。未探测到生命迹象。评估结果：全体一致。

船员们又花了四年时间进行天体物理学勘测。科学家们借此打发时间。

最后一篇日志的日期是第11204天。值班军官描述了一个晴朗的日子。她写道，在这么近的距离看天津四，与当初靠近它时所见的模样截然不同。记录到此结束。

最后的记录只有一个时间戳，没有歉意，也没有反思。仅仅是对星光的一句观察。
texts.en:
The bridge logs begin on Day 9,516 - two days after the vote.

Eleven crew remained to confirm surface clearance. Radiation levels. Population estimates revised downward, then revised again. Day 9,519: bombardment authorized. Day 9,521: sector clearance confirmed, 40%. Day 9,558: surface sterile. No life signatures detected. Assessment: unanimous.

The crew spent four more years on astrophysics surveys. Scientists filling the time.

The final log is dated Day 11,204. The officer on watch describes a clear day. She notes that Deneb looks different from this close than it did on approach. The entry ends there.

The final entry is a timestamp, no apology or reflection. Just an observation about starlight.
